title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.20 is a public research preview of a fail-closed checker for typed mathematical and scientific claims. It adds a bounded, hash-identified crosswalk from the separately published BSC v1.2.0 simulation profile and exact F10 fixture into the existing affine-defect upper-bound kernel. Two closed defect-v0.3 examples and permanent exact-rational regressions replay every F10 prefix and margin. Host B's actual fixture violation remains sourced to the external exact recurrence, state paths, and equality witness through violation_basis=exact_actual_error_above_tolerance; octo does not infer actual violation from an upper bound above tolerance. This release adds no simulation schema, general validator, CLI semantics, or deployment authority. Manifest 0.5.0, the census certificate 0.1.0, older schemas, and theorem semantics remain accepted unchanged. Exact conclusions remain bound to subject, evidence, predicate, scope, method, and authority. Release assets are built from exact tagged Git objects, keylessly attested before publication, and redownloaded for byte comparison. The protocol component remains byte-identical to 0.3.0-alpha.13, and the live Custom GPT remains the separately observed alpha.10 interface; the alpha.20 generated package is only an unvalidated future live-update candidate and indexed Knowledge bytes remain NON_ADMISSIBLE_UNHASHABLE. ChatGPT uploads are processed under the user's applicable terms and settings and are not local-only. This metadata applies to the Apache-2.0 software release assets; research material under research/ is separately governed by CC BY 4.0.
